glh_per_week.why: The floor counts only rows that bank PEQ criteria directly. The ceiling additionally counts every timetabled supervised slot. Resolving that needs the member-gated PEQ delivery guide (not held — _passpq/inputs/README.md) or a coordinator ruling. It is therefore NOT derived here.
